reviews.one_line_contribution: A pre-registered 2x2 provenance experiment in ALFWorld that puts a number, with a confidence interval, on how much of a procedural memory bank's task-type-specific advantage is already held by a GEPA-style instruction optimized on the very same training episodes: the absorbed share A = 1 - Inner(I_own)/Inner(I_oth), with an episode-disjoint same-type instruction (Ladder T, row 4) splitting that share into an episode-level component A_epi and a type-level component A_type.
reviews.closest_prior_work: The proposal itself names the two that matter and concedes both, which is to its credit and also caps it: EvoAgentBench (arXiv 2607.05202) already puts ReasoningBank (+3.6) and GEPA (+1.2) on the same 528/267 trajectories, so the qualitative headline is published; MIPROv2 (arXiv 2406.11695) already established the instruction-versus-demonstration ablation on one training set; ExpeL (arXiv 2308.10144) already stores its memory as a prepended natural-language block, so the two containers are not architecturally distinct in the closest target system. What the Related Work does not engage, and what threatens more than the concession admits, is the ALFWorld-specific manual/guideline line: AutoManual (arXiv 2405.16247, NeurIPS 2024) builds rules from ALFWorld interaction and compiles them into a single markdown manual that replaces per-episode experience lookup, and AutoGuide (arXiv 2403.08978) extracts state-aware guidelines from offline experience and retrieves them. Between them they already establish, in this exact environment, that episodic experience can be rewritten as instruction text and that a compiled manual is competitive with retrieval - which is most of the conceptual content of the compiled-block arm (row 11) and prediction 6, and a large part of the memory-as-instruction framing. Neither performs the provenance crossover, so the identification instrument survives; but the proposal's claim that the compile-once result is a quantified bound rather than a surprise is understated - AutoManual makes it closer to a replication.
reviews.strongest_objection: The confirmatory endpoint is not identified against the most obvious rival, and its decision threshold sits on its own measured noise floor. A = 1 - Inner(I_own)/Inner(I_oth) is a ratio of two on-type-minus-off-type contrasts, and it rises whenever the denominator condition is more bank-dependent - not only when content has moved from episodes into I_own. I_oth is an instruction that a reflective optimizer tuned for the other task set (e.g. an instruction shaped around clean/cool/heat, run on pick_and_place games). A mis-specified instruction gives an on-type bank more to repair, inflating Inner(I_oth) and hence A with zero absorption. The plan has no arm that separates this: Ladder T (row 4) is same-type by construction, so mismatch inflation flows entirely into A_type, and the pre-registered rule in prediction 4 reads A_epi near zero with A_type >= 0.4 as task-type-granular absorption, with the practical conclusion declared unchanged and arguably stronger. So the single most likely benign explanation of a positive result is routed, in advance, into a branch reported as a success. Row 1 gives Inner(I0*) and could diagnose exactly this, but the plan never pre-registers a comparison of Inner(I_oth) against Inner(I0*) as a denominator-inflation check. Layered on top: prediction 1 demands a 90% lower bound >= 0.2, while section (c) expects the treatment-free null replicate (row 10) to sit at 0.12-0.21, i.e. the claim's decision boundary is roughly where the ratio lands with no treatment at all; the pre-registered remedy is to raise n from the balanced reserve, but that reserve is about 230 pooled games (T_B binds at 116) and is already promised to the single G3 re-measurement in the [6,9) window and to any S_test shortfall at freeze. The same games cannot be spent three times, so the only remedy actually available is raising the threshold, which weakens the claim. With G3 described as a deliberate coin flip at a true 9pt effect and power of about 70% at the projected 8pt denominator, the joint probability of a conclusive confirmatory reading is well under half, and the outcome that does arrive is not cleanly separable from instruction mismatch.
reviews.what_would_fix_it: 1. Promote I_all x {B_own, B_oth} to Tier 0 and pre-register A against three denominators - Inner(I0*), Inner(I_all) and Inner(I_oth) - with a rule that the absorption claim requires agreement across them. If Inner(I_oth) materially exceeds Inner(I0*), the denominator is inflated by instruction mismatch and A is not interpretable as absorption; this is nearly free, since I_all is already built for row 5. 2. Make the deployment quantity co-primary rather than secondary. Prediction 6 currently asserts the practitioner conclusion from a bounded loss - the 90% CI of g(I_all, B_all) lying below 3pt - but at n = 800 the CI half-width is 1.7-2.3pt, so that bound is satisfied by a true gain of 2.5pt, half the gated 5pt effect. Replace it with a formal equivalence test against a pre-specified margin, powered accordingly, since that is the number a practitioner would act on and the number the title implicitly claims. 3. Take the frontier reflector the track explicitly budgets for (a few hundred dollars for the reflection/optimizer role). Refusing it because no key is on the node is a self-inflicted handicap that makes G2 a live failure branch, shrinks the level gap the study needs, and weakens I_own - the proposal argues this is conservative for A, but it mainly lowers the chance the study concludes at all. 4. Run pre-freeze obligation (1) - the provenance-crossover search in the contamination and data-attribution literatures - before submission rather than before the design freeze, and open the appendix of arXiv 2608.14036. The novelty claim is explicitly conditional on both, and a conditional novelty claim is not a novelty claim. 5. Resolve the reserve arithmetic: the allocation table lists S_screen as its own 150-per-set line while the screening section says S_screen is drawn from the reserve, and the same ~230-game balanced reserve is separately promised to G3 extension, null-floor remediation and S_test shortfall. Either enlarge T_B (the official valid_seen and valid_unseen sets are currently held out for a Tier-1 check) or cut arms.
reviews.missing_baseline: Inner at the deployed instruction: I_all x {B_own, B_oth}. Row 5 runs I_all only against M0 and B_all, so the relevance advantage is never measured at the pooled instruction a practitioner would actually ship - the one instruction in the design that is optimizer-exposed but not provenance-labelled toward either type set. Its absence is what leaves the I_oth denominator unchecked and what forces the deployment claim to rest on a single absolute gain with a 2pt-wide CI. A second, cheaper omission from Tier 0: raw retrieved trajectories at I_own with no distillation. The proposal's own cited audit (arXiv 2603.02473) reports that raw chunks match lossy writes, so if undistilled trajectories retain the advantage at the optimized instruction while distilled items do not, the finding is about distillation rather than absorption. R_raw exists only as part of a Tier-1 long-context dump ladder and is cuttable.
reviews.preprint_collision: Not thin - this is among the more disciplined collision checks I have seen in a proposal: two dated scans (2026-08-21, 2026-09-03), 15 HuggingFace queries over 244 papers, by-id verification of 54 arXiv IDs, a full 15-page PDF read of the closest competitor with the extracted text committed under SHA256, a self-correction of a misreported ReasoningBank number (+7 to +3.6), and reinstatement of five IDs wrongly retracted in v2. It should be credited as a model of the practice. But it establishes collision, not clearance. The proposal's own finding is that EvoAgentBench (arXiv 2607.05202) already publishes the qualitative claim on shared training trajectories, so what remains is instrument plus number - the authors say so plainly, which is honest but is also the ceiling on the novelty score. Three residual weaknesses are real. First, the one search that would settle the novelty claim - held-out-episode and data-provenance crossovers in the prompt-optimization, contamination and data-attribution literatures - has never been run from this node and is deferred as a freeze-blocking obligation; a novelty claim conditional on an unrun search is not established, and this is a weakness rather than a neutral. Second, arXiv is unreachable from the node, so most 2026 IDs rest on a single channel and every confirmed absent from the paper claim except EvoAgentBench's is asserted from an abstract - which is precisely the evidence standard that would miss a GEPA-plus-memory ablation buried in a systems-paper appendix, the residual risk the proposal itself names. Third, the check looks forward but not back: AutoManual (arXiv 2405.16247) and AutoGuide (arXiv 2403.08978) already convert ALFWorld experience into a compiled manual and into retrievable guidelines respectively, and neither appears anywhere in the scan. That is a pre-2026 collision with the compile-once arm (row 11) and prediction 6 that a recency-weighted preprint sweep structurally could not catch, and it suggests the scan's calibration is tilted too far toward the last six months.

reviews.one_line_contribution: A pre-registered ALFWorld measurement of what fraction of a procedural-memory bank's task-type-specific value is already held by a GEPA-optimized instruction built from the same episodes, identified by crossing instruction provenance with bank provenance (the task-type provenance square) and reported as a scale-free absorbed share A = 1 - Inner(I_own)/Inner(I_oth) with a treatment-free null replicate of the ratio itself.
reviews.closest_prior_work: The proposal names EvoAgentBench (arXiv 2607.05202) itself and concedes it publishes the qualitative headline: ReasoningBank (+3.6) and GEPA (+1.2) on the same 528/267 trajectories on Qwen3.5-27B. That concession is correct and it is the paper that caps this contribution. But the threat I can actually verify from my own knowledge is the pair MIPROv2 (arXiv 2406.11695) plus ExpeL (arXiv 2308.10144). MIPROv2 already factorizes a prompt into instructions and bootstrapped demonstrations, optimizes each alone on one training set, and reports that the split is task-dependent -- that is the two-container substitution ablation, on the same episodes, with a published answer. ExpeL already distills training episodes into an insights block and prepends it, so the memory bank in the closest target system IS an instruction; the proposal states this in its own first paragraph. Given those two, what is left is (a) provenance labelling of both containers, (b) the episode-disjoint same-type instruction I'(T,r), (c) the ratio endpoint, (d) the item-overlap dose-response, and (e) the ALFWorld setting where the effect is 5-15pt rather than 0.6-3.6pt. That residue is a real but modest delta over MIPROv2-with-retrieval, and the proposal's own framing (identification-and-quantification, not a new phenomenon) is an accurate self-assessment rather than false modesty.
reviews.strongest_objection: The confirmatory endpoint's denominator is not a neutral reference, and the bracket does not bracket the resulting bias. Inner(I_oth) is measured at an instruction that was optimized on the OTHER type set's episodes and is then applied to own-type test games. I_oth is not merely a lower-accuracy instruction; it is a mis-specified one -- an instruction tuned to locate-carry-to-appliance-operate procedure being run on fetch-and-place games (and vice versa) will actively push wrong procedure. B_own then repairs that damage, and the repair is scored as relevance advantage in the denominator, inflating A toward the 0.5 threshold. Nothing in the plan corrects this channel. A_h = (l_own - l_oth)/(1 - l_oth) is a scalar level correction under a multiplicative headroom model, and mis-specification is precisely a shape effect, not a level effect: the deficit concentrates on exactly the games where on-type memory helps, which is the one place a uniform-compression model cannot reach. And the over-correcting end of the bracket, Ladder T, only ever produces same-type instructions I'(T,r) from the disjoint pool P'_train, so it titrates level while never instantiating wrong-type procedure -- the bracket is silent on the very channel that most inflates A. The result is that the headline 'the instruction already contains the bank' is observationally confounded with 'a wrong-type instruction is a handicap that an on-type bank removes', which would be a statement about instruction mis-specification, not about container substitution. Row 1 already measures Inner(I0*), so the cleaner denominator exists in the grid and is deliberately not used. A second, internal edge of the same problem: G3 demands Inner(I0*) >= 9pt while G1 fixes help(I0*) >= 5pt, so passing G3 with adequate power essentially requires the off-type bank to HARM by several points relative to no memory -- exactly what the proposal's own cited ALFWorld literature on retrieval pollution (2604.27003, 2608.15008) predicts. But a large off-type harm term is what drives ChangeInner through the off component, and Rule M then routes the reading to distractor-robustness rather than absorption. The design's power requirement and its mechanism rule pull in opposite directions: the most likely path to a powered study is also the most likely path to a non-confirmatory one.
reviews.what_would_fix_it: (1) Make A against Inner(I0*) a co-primary endpoint rather than a row-1 side quantity, and pre-register the diagnostic that separates absorption from repair-of-mis-specification: report, at item granularity, whether B_own at I_oth fixes games that I0* already solves. If the on-type bank at I_oth is mostly recovering games I0* gets right, the denominator is measuring instruction damage and A is not an absorbed share. Also pre-register a check that Inner(I_oth) is not materially larger than Inner(I0*), and declare the primary uninterpretable if it is. (2) Promote I_type and a provenance-labelled compiled block (C_own vs C_oth) into the Tier-0 square. The proposal's own most-likely branch is A_epi ~ 0 with A_type >= 0.4, and that branch is uninterpretable without I_type, which currently sits in Tier 1 inside the cut list. (3) Fix the partition rationale or the partition. T_A = {pick_and_place, pick_two, look_in_light} is justified as 'fetch-and-place, no object state change', but look_at_obj_in_light requires finding and toggling a desklamp -- a device operation, which is the stated defining feature of T_B. Either justify the split on the measured retrieval-overlap criterion alone and drop the procedural story, or move look_in_light and re-derive the counts (T_B's reserve of ~116 games is already the binding constraint). (4) Buy back the third optimizer seed by cutting rows 13 and 15. With two seeds the crossed random effect for optimizer run in the mixed-effects model is not estimable, the cluster bootstrap over optimizer runs resamples two clusters, and the quoted 0.8pt-per-run variance component is transferred wholesale from E1 multi-hop QA and cannot be checked in ALFWorld. (5) Run pre-freeze obligation (1) -- the data-provenance-crossover search in the contamination and data-attribution literatures -- before submission and report it, not as a conditional promise; the only unshared claim in the proposal is conditional on a search that has never been run. (6) Move the official valid_seen / valid_unseen cells out of Tier 1: the 5-15pt literature prior that G1 is benchmarked against was measured on those splits, not on 1,200 held-out training games.
reviews.missing_baseline: A provenance-labelled static instruction produced by distillation WITHOUT the optimizer, run inside the square. The plan has C_all only in the pooled practitioner row 11 and C_own only at Tier 1, so no Tier-0 cell answers whether the absorbed share requires a reflective optimizer at all or is simply what happens when the same episodes are written into prose. Given the proposal's own concession that ExpeL's insight block is already an instruction, {C_own, C_oth} x {B_own, B_oth} is the arm a reviewer will demand, and its absence means the paper cannot distinguish 'GEPA absorbed the bank' from 'any prose summary of these episodes absorbs the bank', which is a materially weaker and already-published claim. Two further omissions from Tier 0 that reviewers will name: I_type (what the three task-type LABELS alone buy, with no episodes) -- decisive for the pre-registered A_epi ~ 0 / A_type large branch yet currently droppable; and the whole-bank long-context dump M_all / R_raw, which the proposal itself motivates by citing EvoMemBench (2605.18421) finding long-context baselines competitive against fifteen memory methods, then relegates to a cuttable tier.
reviews.preprint_collision: The check is unusually strong by proposal standards -- a dated scan (2026-09-03), 15 HuggingFace queries over 244 papers, by-id abstract verification for 54 arXiv IDs, the closest competitor's PDF read in full with its extracted text committed under SHA256, and a corrected error (ReasoningBank's Qwen gain is +3.6, not the +7 a web snippet reported). It also concedes rather than hides the collision: EvoAgentBench (2607.05202) already publishes the qualitative headline, and ExpeL (2308.10144) already makes memory-as-instruction a design pattern. That honesty is worth credit and I take the concession at face value. Three problems remain, and they are not neutral. First, the single search that bears on the proposal's only unshared claim -- held-out-episode and data-provenance crossovers in the prompt-optimization, contamination and data-attribution literatures -- has never been run from this node and is deferred to a pre-freeze obligation. The proposal states the contribution reduces to the ALFWorld measurement if that search lands. A novelty claim conditional on an unrun search is an unestablished novelty claim, and it happens to be the exact primitive most likely to already exist: leave-a-subset-out attribution of a learned artifact's benefit to the data that produced it is a standard move, and I would expect at least a prompt-optimization variant of it to exist by now. Second, arXiv is unreachable from the node, so every 2026 ID rests on a single web-search channel, and the plan admits that 'confirmed absent from the paper' is asserted from abstracts for every competitor except EvoAgentBench. The one snippet they could cross-check was already wrong, which is direct evidence that the channel is unreliable, and the entire Related Work section's positioning depends on it. I cannot verify any of the post-May-2026 IDs myself; the pre-cutoff ones (2308.10144, 2406.11695, 2502.12110, 2507.19457, 2508.06433, 2509.25140) do check out. Third, obligation (2) names an unopened appendix -- arXiv 2608.14036 -- as a live collision for prediction 6 (compile-once beats live retrieval at matched tokens). That is a known, specific, unresolved collision on a headline prediction, flagged but not cleared. Net: not an unsearched claim of novelty, but a searched claim whose one load-bearing search is outstanding and whose verification channel has a demonstrated error rate.

reviews.one_line_contribution: A 2x2 'provenance square' in ALFWorld that crosses the episode-provenance of a GEPA-optimized instruction against the task-type relevance of a distilled procedural memory bank, and reports the resulting 'absorbed share' A = 1 - Inner(I_own)/Inner(I_oth) as a scale-free ratio with a confidence interval and a null replicate — i.e., putting a number and an identification strategy on a substitution claim the literature has so far only asserted qualitatively.
reviews.closest_prior_work: EvoAgentBench (cited as arXiv 2607.05202) is the real threat: it already puts ReasoningBank (+3.6) and GEPA (+1.2) on the *same* 528/267 training trajectories, which is the qualitative headline ('an optimizer given the same episodes gets roughly what the bank gets'). The proposal concedes this in its first paragraph, and correctly notes EvoAgentBench has no provenance manipulation, no combined optimizer+memory cell, no token matching and no paired statistics — so the interaction is genuinely unidentified there. What the proposal never answers is the reviewer's follow-up: which practical decision flips between 'roughly equal gains on a shared pool' and 'A = 0.6 with a 90% LB of 0.25'? If the answer is 'none', the increment is a measurement refinement. Two secondary threats: ExpeL (2308.10144), whose distilled insights block *is* a prepended instruction, meaning the two 'containers' are not architecturally distinct in the closest target system; and Experience Distillation (2607.21051), which already establishes the retention-ratio measurement object (>=64.8% of the in-context gain retained) with weights as the second container — the proposal admits this is where its ratio endpoint came from. MIPROv2 (2406.11695) is a weaker threat since it neither retrieves nor manipulates provenance. I cannot independently verify the 2026-dated IDs.
reviews.strongest_objection: The confirmatory reading is unpowered exactly where it tests the title. The proposal says 'the confirmatory reading is taken at the conservative end' and names Ladder T (A_epi) as that end, but the operational bar it then states is A - A_h >= 0.30, where A_h = 0.06-0.12 is the *least* aggressive of the two candidate corrections. The two are not the same requirement, and the text never resolves which one gates publication. If it is A_epi (prediction 4: A_epi >= 0.2), the claim rests on the least-precise number in the study: row 4 is n=500 with ONE optimizer seed, and Inner-hat' is *interpolated* between two ladder levels. Using the proposal's own arithmetic, instance SE = sqrt(0.20/500) = 2.0pt, plus 0.8pt optimizer = ~2.2pt per level against a 6-8pt quantity; propagating that through the ratio gives SE(A_epi) ~ 0.3, so a 90% LB >= 0.2 needs A_epi-hat near 0.6. The MDE table covers only A and stops precisely where A_epi and A_type begin — the one quantity that separates 'these episodes' from 'this task type' has no stated MDE. If instead the bar is only A - A_h >= 0.30, the bracket is decorative and the sole correction applied is the multiplicative-headroom model, which is wrong in the direction that inflates A: I_own solves the type-specific-easy games first, so its residual unsolved set is depleted of exactly the games B_own can fix. That is selection on the residual set, not uniform compression, and A_h does not bound it. Compounding this: the denominator's reference instruction I_oth is not neutral — G3b actively *requires* it to be 3pt worse on own-type games, i.e. the design gates on the mis-specialization that inflates Inner(I_oth); an instruction optimized to 'go to the microwave' will fail T_A games in ways the on-type bank repairs, driving A toward 1 with zero content transfer. And by the proposal's own risk 8, the treatment-free null floor of A is expected at 0.12-0.21 against a 0.2 decision threshold — the endpoint's noise floor overlaps its own decision rule, which is the track brief's stated out-of-scope condition applied to the primary. The honest forecast is an inconclusive primary plus a fallback paper.
reviews.what_would_fix_it: (1) State ONE operational confirmatory bar and power it. If Ladder T is the conservative end, run its two bracketing levels at row-2 scale (n=1,200, two optimizer seeds) and publish MDE rows for A_epi and A_type next to the existing table for A; pay for it out of rows 13 (coupling), 15 (step control) and one seed of row 12. (2) Stop using a deliberately mis-specialized instruction as the denominator's reference. Promote I_all x {B_own, B_oth} to Tier 0 so Inner is also read at an instruction that saw both type sets' episodes, and report A0 = 1 - Inner(I_own)/Inner(I0*) alongside A; if A and A0 disagree, the gap is the negative-transfer artifact. (3) Add the bank-side mirror of I': B'_own distilled from P'_train (same three types, disjoint episodes). Episode-vs-type granularity is currently testable only on the instruction side. (4) Promote M_shuf (within-domain, token-matched, retrieval bypassed) to Tier 0. X_dist is reformatted multi-hop-QA text — out-of-domain and trivially ignorable — while B_oth is topically plausible ALFWorld procedure; the track's own prior finding is that the harmful bank retrieved topically *correct* items, so X_dist does not control the distractor-robustness rival that Rule M routes to. (5) Use the frontier reflector the track brief explicitly grants ('a few hundred dollars total') for at least the I_own/I_oth arms. The proposal's 'no API key on this node' contradicts its own resource envelope, self-imposes a weak I_own, and turns G2 into a live coin flip for no scientific gain. (6) Enforce 'same episodes' by episode-set identity rather than by capping GEPA at 350 rollouts; as written the treatment instruction gets one sweep while the Ladder T control gets 500-750, and the fairness constraint is the reason G2 may fail.
reviews.missing_baseline: The episode-disjoint BANK, B'_own — the same three task types distilled from P'_train, the pool that produced I'. The design manipulates episode provenance only on the instruction side, so the central sentence ('the same training episodes in two containers') is tested asymmetrically: if B'_own yields the same Inner as B_own, the bank carries only type-level content and the episode framing is dead on the container the paper is about, regardless of what A_epi says. It costs one distillation and one grid cell. Runner-up omissions a reviewer would also demand at Tier 0: Inner measured at the practitioner instruction (I_all x {B_own, B_oth}), and M_shuf as the within-domain distractor control.
reviews.preprint_collision: The check is well above the norm for a proposal — a dated fresh scan (2026-09-03), 15 HuggingFace queries over 244 papers, 54 by-id abstract verifications, one competitor PDF read in full with a committed SHA256, a self-correction of a misreported +7 to +3.6, and a reinstatement of five citations wrongly retracted in an earlier version. It also concedes the two collisions that actually matter (EvoAgentBench's shared-trajectory table; ExpeL's memory-as-instruction) in the first paragraph of Related Work rather than burying them. I credit that. But it has three defects that bear directly on the novelty score. (a) The search that most threatens the claimed contribution has never been run: the proposal admits the provenance/held-out-data crossover primitive in the contamination and data-attribution literatures is unsearched from this node, marks it 'freeze-blocking', and makes its novelty claim explicitly conditional on it. An unrun search on the exact primitive the identification rests on is a weakness, not a neutral, and the proposal pre-concedes that a hit reduces the contribution to 'the ALFWorld measurement'. (b) arXiv is unreachable from the node, so every 2026 ID except EvoAgentBench rests on a single web-snippet channel, and every 'confirmed absent from the paper' claim about a competitor is asserted from an abstract — including the absences that carry the novelty argument. (c) The appendix of arXiv 2608.14036 is unopened and is named by the authors as the collision that would gut prediction 6 (compile-once). I am aware of no preprint through my own knowledge that runs this specific provenance square, and the nearest published claims are the ones the authors named; but the proposal's own verdict — 'the contribution is the identification and the number, not the idea' — is the collision finding a reviewer would write, and it caps novelty rather than establishing it.
